value.Title: CPI
value.Description: Index number that measures the price change of goods and services purchased by Dutch households for their own consumption.

value.Title: Derived CPI
value.Description: The derived consumer price index excludes the effect of changes in the rates of product-related taxes (e.g. VAT and duty on alcohol and tobacco) and subsidies.

value.Title: Monthly rate of change CPI
value.Description: Percentage change of the CPI compared with previous month.

value.Title: Monthly rate of change derived CPI
value.Description: Percentage change of the derived CPI compared with previous month.

value.Title: Annual rate of change CPI
value.Description: Percentage change of the CPI compared with the same period previous year.

value.Title: Annual rate of change derived CPI
value.Description: Percentage change of the derived CPI compared with the same period previous year.

value.Title: Weighting coefficient
value.Description: The weighting coefficient reflects the share (in hundred thousandths) of the total consumer expenditure.
